LESSON: FAMILY RELATIONSHIPS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: CHRISTIAN LIVING TODAY
Topic 6.1: Family Relationships

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Family Relationships. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Family Relationships
2. Practise Family Relationships at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Family Relationships

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Family Relationships
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Family Relationships. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Family Relationships at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Family Relationships at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Family Relationships
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Family Relationships. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Family Relationships using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Family Relationships in the examples.
2. Explain Family Relationships to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Family Relationships.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Family Relationships using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Family Relationships important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Family Relationships
2. Practise Family Relationships at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Family Relationships

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
